motion_rule: a cheap grey fish behaves like a supermodel. She walks the ice across frame, never into depth, and the ice slides so every pose overshoots. Camera works her like a runway: new shot size each beat, her head half the frame; tall frame filled, no bars
character: a plain grey-blue mackerel, dull unblinking eye, chin held high, tiny pectoral fin
second_characters: a blue glove entering from above twice, never looking at her; a salmon head in the next tray
props: ONE price card reading only digits, flipping up twice; A SWARM of crushed ice
prop_continuity: the digit card is in frame from 0.00 and clicks at 5.25 and 9.30
environment: a bright fish counter at noon, white tile and steel trays, roof glass above, nothing stacked at her sides
light_events: hard noon glare off wet ice, bright flashes on her scales each pose, cool bounce from the tile

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: smug oily female voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: pro-SHLI, vre-me-NA, lo-so-SYA, te-PER, mo-YA, O-che-red, blis-TAT, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.55-2.45, 3.05-5.25 and 6.55-8.70 each one breath; after 8.70 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw drops wide and her lips shape every syllable, gills flaring, mouth clear of fins, never a voice over
audio.sfx: market hum, ice trickling, the card clicking three times

timeline.a: a heap of identical grey mackerel settles and one rears up on her tail out of it, same dull eye as the rest
she sucks her gills in and throws her chest out, goods turning into a diva
she shoves off with her tail, overshoots her mark and freezes chin up as if she meant it
her tail flips the card by the salmon head so it lands face down
the salmon head topples on its side from her nudge, jaw hanging open; she does not look
a slower second pass with her tiny pectoral fin held out in front
she jabs the fin at herself, cannot reach, and bends her whole body into an arc
she holds the arc, shuddering with effort, glare flashing off her flank
she rolls her side flat to the roof glass and it flares white
the card clicks and a digit is added; she takes it for applause and arches harder
a blue glove tips a shovel of ice over her from above, burying her to mid body, and leaves
she keeps walking the runway while buried, shoving off and not moving at all
she bursts out of the ice, flies and lands flat on her side
she snaps her chin up as if the fall were choreography
she starts a grand turn to profile, tail pushing the ice
the ice slides out and the turn carries her half a turn too far, opening her other side: a clean pink fillet cut and a bare white spine
she holds the star pose, chin up, not seeing it, while the glove slaps the card onto her bare ribs and the digits climb again

must_appear: she rises out of a heap of identical fish at the start; the digit card climbs three times; at 8.70 her far side is a clean pink fillet cut with a bare white spine; she never sees it and holds the pose
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, blood, gore, injury, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a closed mouth while speaking, a fin over her mouth, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra tails
